observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a wooden stage decorated with traditional Balinese floral arrangements, offerings, and umbrellas, in front of an ornate temple gateway with stone guardian statues; musicians seated on the right side
observation.dancers: two female dancers, performing as a pair
observation.formation_and_space: symmetric side-by-side positioning, mirroring each other's movements across the stage space
observation.posture: low, wide stance with deep knee bends, torso upright with pronounced lower back curve and chest lifted
observation.footwork: frequent quick shuffles and steps on the balls of the feet coordinated with rapid percussive changes in weight; precise rhythmic foot placement matching the gamelan beats
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held wide with elbows bent at shoulder height, wrists flexed sharply, and fingers articulated in expressive gestures (mudras); holding traditional gold folding fans in one hand
observation.hips_and_torso: sharp lateral hip shifts and torso twists, matching the angular movements of head and eyes
observation.levels_jumps_turns: transitions between standing in deep plié and kneeling low to the ground; subtle turns and pivots without jumps
observation.costume_and_props: ornate gold and purple patterned traditional Balinese dance costumes with elaborate collars and long sashes (stagen), elaborate gilded headdresses adorned with yellow and white flowers, heavy makeup with expressive eyebrow styling; holding gold folding fans
observation.cannot_infer: exact subtleties of footwork articulation and fast toe-heel weight shifts obscured by distance and stage lighting

signature_moments.what: dancers enter from the gateway in a low, wide squat, arms extended wide with fluttering fan gestures and rapid eye movements
synchronous descent to a low kneeling position while keeping fans and fingers articulating sharply to the music
prolonged kneeling sequence with intricate hand articulation and sharp head turns to right and left
